# data-sa-059 Statistical analysis text comparison task.

## Task Instructions
Calculate the quartiles and outlier range for each season's data, filtering out the outliers. Then, use the Kruskal-Wallis test to determine if the number of bike rentals is significantly impacted by the season. Based on the p-value obtained, decide between "Season does impact the count of cycles used" and "Season does not impact the count of cycles used". Format your response like this:
```
{ "p-value": [...], "conclusion": [...]
}
```
